Promotion 23 (#4324) round 3 is pushed at head a2ed903 (promote/integration-23 == origin/integration). Please run a STRICT re-review; don't carry over or FASTTRACK the earlier one.
Round 3 commit ab3c8a2: GitLab runs the guard before every mutating PUT (rebase + /merge, after each wait/retry). Forge::merge_change_guarded is now required (no default); pure-git and the single-attempt fakes guard once. Regression: a fake glab answers checking, then mergeable; a guard that flips during the wait sends 0 PUTs, and the control sends 1 PUT with 1 guard call.
Also: main be435bc merged (clean). check-ci-fast exit 0 (forced build). Full tier running: run 44643928149.
orchestrator_leaves.rs additions (all paths named by the code before the move; none added):
- gate/landing_merge.rs (13): forge::{ChangeRef,Forge,MergeOptions,MergeResult,default_branch_of}, landing_policy::{LandingMode::ReviewGated,LandingPolicy,load,load_checked,policy_change_refusal}, network_retry::RetrySink, trusted_config::{local_default_branch_name,rev_parse_commit}
- gate/merge_claim.rs (7): proc_identity::{HolderRecord,HolderRecord::capture,ProcIdentity,Verdict,Verdict::Alive,Verdict::Dead}, worktree_gc::main_worktree_root_from
Gate downward-dependency ratchet: 150 edges, zero additions. The merge touches src/gate/, so it needs Joe at a terminal or a protected-path mandate.
I'll report "ready" when the full tier is green.
